messages:
elaine: FYI the API ref 429 example for /v1/generate only shows a JSON error body but doesn't include the Retry-After header in the curl sample. customers trying to implement backoff copy the example and miss the header.

ross: yikes. where is the mismatch? OpenAPI responses or generated examples?

elaine: openapi/errors.yaml has the 429 response example body, but the generated curl block omits the header in the response example. the SDK snippets also never call out reading Retry-After.

samir: I can fix the examples. plan: update OpenAPI to include `headers: Retry-After: { schema: { type: string } }` on the 429 response, update curl example to show `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 5

{ "error": { "message": "rate limit exceeded" } }`, and add a short JS/Python snippet showing how to read `response.headers['retry-after']` / `resp.headers.get('Retry-After')`.

ross: also add a note in the error-handling section recommending exponential backoff with jitter and mention the numeric value is seconds. some folks assume milliseconds.

elaine: good call. can we add a tiny docs CI check that parses example responses and asserts Retry-After exists for 429 responses? we tend to miss header examples in new endpoints.

samir: added `tools/docs/validate_error_headers.py` and wired into docs CI in the PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892  updates openapi/errors.yaml, examples and snippets, docs-ci test and a changelog bullet.

docs-ci: docs-ci started for PR 4892 (:building_construction:)

ross: small nit: make sure to use lowercase header key in code examples for fetch (`resp.headers.get('retry-after')`) to match browser behavior.

samir: fixed header casing in JS snippet and added a one-line migration note: "If you relied on 429 examples without a Retry-After header, update your client to read Retry-After and use it to schedule retries."

docs-ci: docs-ci passed for PR 4892 (:white_check_mark:) https://ci.internal.redwood/4892

elaine: reviewed and approved. can we backport the example-only change to `stable/docs` branch? support wants it ASAP.

ross: cherry-picked the example commit to stable and pushed. closing the issue.

samir: merged and backported. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.

elaine: nice, should save a bunch of support time.
